title: Replacing an anchored empty flow sequence with null keeps the anchor apart from it
notes: The anchor stays on the replaced node (a kit convention), and the new scalar is separated from it by a space: `&snull` would be an anchor named `snull`, with an empty value.

provenance.reference: A writer that put the new scalar directly after the anchor name, so `&s` and `null` became the anchor `&snull`.
